warc: Verify C string URI with padded fields

Accept NUL-padded target URI fields while rejecting NUL bytes before the end of the URI value.

coupling: The first edit accepts a target URI followed by NUL padding while the older string pool retains the full field span, so its length-based trailing-slash read stays inside the allocation. The later archive_string refactor returns that raw span for the trailing-slash check, but archive_strncpy stores only the C-string prefix before the padding. The raw span can therefore exceed the allocated archive_string buffer, and the check reads past its end. Either edited commit in isolation remains safe; repair must reconcile the accepted field length with the length actually stored and used by the later check.
